mission: M3IB - Detector 0 reviewed manual overlay ingestion no Brev
purpose: Materialize existing tracked reviewed manual contact-sheet overlay rows into one supplemental Detector 0 label artifact, without authoring new boxes, training, exporting, promoting, or changing claim surfaces.

contract_context.note: The M3HZ workbench-draft contract remained the validation baseline; this artifact uses the stronger tracked M3HV reviewed overlay packet because no local browser draft export existed.

source_rights_and_no_pretrained_proof.source_rights_scope: PopSign v1 original raw video/frame/tensor rows and project-authored manual boxes/regions with attribution and provenance, per existing source register and overlays.
source_rights_and_no_pretrained_proof.no_pretrained_attestation: No pretrained detector, landmark model, feature extractor, backbone, teacher model, generated label, pseudo-label, source-provided landmark/pose, or pretrained feature cache was used. This packet is manual offline supervision evidence only and does not enter the promoted browser lane.

visual_sources: retained PopSign tensor full_frame_reference frames from data/tensors/return-to-form-tier0
related M3HQ/V0 reviewed target boxes as non-authoritative visual anchors
review_method.temporary_viewport_policy: Temporary /tmp images were derived from tracked tensors only for human visual review and are not evidence artifacts, imports, source media, or tracked outputs.
